meta.title: "Remove unused declaration" does not work on overloaded function declarations
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#57517 (fix(57497): "Remove unused declaration" does not work on overloaded function declarations), 93451e8dd9, 2024-04-19; git tag --contains: first in v5.5-beta / v5.5.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@5.4.5 (2024-04-10) and typescript@5.5.2 (2024-06-20), both behind typescript-language-server@4.3.3 (the latest wrapper release before 5.5.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session.
meta.notes: Only the single quick fix is probed (the fix-all 'Delete all unused declarations' of the same report is not exposed as a per-fix action by the wrapper).

settings_note: tsconfig.json is scaffolding for the issue's playground link: noUnusedLocals=true (named in the link and the text) and moduleDetection force (the playground treats every file as a module; in a script file a top-level function is a global and is never reported as unused).

files.note: noUnusedLocals from the issue's playground link; moduleDetection force as in the playground, so the function is a module-local declaration

repro.steps: Open index.ts with noUnusedLocals on: foo is reported as declared but never read (TS6133). Apply the quick fix 'Remove unused declaration for: foo'. Reported: only one of the overloads is removed, so the unused diagnostic stays; expected: the whole overloaded declaration is removed. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted TS6133 nor a new error.
